Rows generated here are mining evidence only; promotion should follow sample review and source-specific guards.

method.identity_gate: exact Japanese label plus existing single-reading verification; ambiguous multi-reading surfaces are rejected unless the surface itself is kana-exact
method.query_shape: candidate Japanese labels are sent as SPARQL VALUES, then matched only when a Wikidata item with that exact Japanese label is an instance or subclass of a configured narrow topic root
